note: BUNDLE v2 = the 34 user-approved X3 CC0 substitution picks (review UI 2026-07-29, decisions.json: all 34 x3 rows verdict=approve; the 3 vitals items — brass-plaques, bz-recolour, kept-trio — approved in the same pass). One entry per approved rsId, full PBR path for every entry: CC0 ambientCG 1K Color + NormalGL + scalar roughness + install-time gain (+ per-channel tint on 4 rows). 512x512 CAP: Color and NormalGL are Lanczos-downscaled from 1K before packing. Full 1K x34 x2 planes x2 wasm instances (main + bake worker) is ~480 MB of resident override bytes — not acceptable on the 8 GB box; the 512 cap costs ~59.5 MB per instance (34 x (512*512*4 rgba + 512*512*3 normal) = 62,390,272 B). Normals are plain-resized at this 2:1 ratio and deliberately NOT renormalized. roughness = mean(_Roughness)/255 (3dp). gain = retailMeanRGB / candidateMeanRGB computed on the FULL-RES Color vs the retail RenderSurface PNG (statics-x1/x4-input/<rsId>.png), 3dp. tint[c] = (retailMean_c / candidateMean_c) / gain, clamped [0.25,4], 3dp, so gain x tint reproduces the per-channel ratio exactly; applied to the 3 X3 hue-retint rows (0x060038FC, 0x06003D72, 0x060038F0) and to 0x06003C25 as the eyetest NOTE A warm regrade. SUPERSEDES pilot v1 (6 ESRGAN x4 diffuse-only heads + the 1K PavingStones146/Planks036B entries); pilot v1 backed up verbatim to /mnt/wbterminal2/pbr-terrain/tex-overrides-pilot-v1/. CAVEAT (unchanged from v1, 5.6): __texOverrideStats().hits is PER-INSTANCE and stays 0 even when overrides are demonstrably rendering (bake-worker decodes do not tick the main counter) — do NOT use hits as a liveness signal; use __atlasStats() new-size buckets (512x512 layers that cannot otherwise exist) or a ?statAtlas=off probe traversal matching the roughness fingerprint. Paletted (P8/Index16) records are refused by construction.
